assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient visual disturbances concerning for transient cerebral ischemic attacks in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered.
CPT 93229 is the code for Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The associated diagnoses G45.9 and I49.5 support the medical necessity of this service.
Coverage for CPT 93229 is denied under Reason Code PR-204.
Reason Code PR-204 indicates that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
This specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
